title: E2E executor schema
description: Test package build outputs via npm pack + tarball install.

packageDir.description: Path to the built package directory, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to the build output of the first project this one implicitly depends on that has a build target.

testDir.description: Path to E2E test project directory relative to workspace root. Defaults to the current project root.

name.description: The name the run is reported under.

specs.description: The spec files it runs, relative to the test project.

timeoutMs.description: Per-test timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.

dom.description: Whether the run needs the DOM preload.

serialOn.description: The platforms (process.platform values) on which the suites run one at a time.

formats.description: What to test: 'cjs', 'esm' and 'browser' run the conventional spec files (browser runs the IIFE and UMD specs against the DOM preload); an object names a suite of the project's own. Defaults to cjs, esm, and browser.

skipInstall.description: Skip npm pack and install step (useful if already installed).
